info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Careers Applications Documents-v1-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Documents API provides access to documents associated with job applications in a streamlined manner. This API allows developers to retrieve, view, and manage relevant documents submitted by applicants for various career opportunities. Typical consumers include HR teams, recruitment platforms, and application tracking systems that require easy access to candidate documentation. Seamlessly integrate this API into your solutions to enhance application review processes and improve efficiency.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of documents related to applications.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all documents associated with specific applications. You can use query parameters to filter and refine the documents returned based on your needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is utilized to retrieve documents related to applications. It expects a JSON format, ensuring the data provided adheres to the predefined schema. Make sure that all required fields are included for successful processing.
